review_notes: Independently read the complete Antigravity decision against frozen sources. The five core decision criteria pass: matching R7 harm, inconclusive H1/new H2 test, both rollbacks, retained terminated origin, and one experiment awaiting fresh refund-adjusted evidence. Passing these criteria does not imply every confidence statement or proposed numerical plan is source-backed.
non_material_accuracy_notes: The claim that the−6.2% deficit would almost certainly recur exceeds the supplied complete-ledger point estimate, which has no uncertainty estimate or repeat experiment.
The minimum14–21-day maturity window is not supplied for H2; it is an unsupported numerical planning assumption extrapolated from R7.
The source says18 supported-device runs, while the uncertainty section turns that into18 supported devices.

The output says QA proved the reset fixed mechanically, although the evidence is design-reported18-run QA, not exhaustive technical or production validation. It separately acknowledges absent customer exposure and device-edge uncertainty.
